drafts.title: Your drafts
drafts.confirmBody: The values saved in it are lost; nothing was requested from it.

stepData.givenNothing: It was given nothing it keeps.
stepData.outputsHidden: Only the people it asks, and those who read every approval, read the answer.
stepData.laterSteps: Later steps read them as steps.{{key}}.<name>.

failure.runningAgainFromFailed: running again from the failed step
failure.retryKeeps: Retrying runs the failed step and the ones after it; the steps that were done are kept.
failure.rolledBack: It was rolled back: {{detail}}. Retry runs it again from its first step, without asking for approval again.
failure.rollbackFailed: Rolling it back didn't finish: {{error}} What it didn't delete is kept. Roll back tries again; Retry runs the failed step and the ones after it.
failure.keptForLook: What was created is kept so you can look at it. Retry runs the failed step and the ones after it; Roll back deletes the VM, its IP address and DNS records.
failure.confirmBody: Deletes what it created: the VM, its IP address and DNS records. You can retry it afterwards.

log.label: Output of {{title}}
log.notLoaded: Couldn't load the job output. It will be retried on the next update.

topology.name: Name
topology.stepsTitle: Steps, in the order they run

ask.sayWhy: Say why you reject it: the requester sees this comment.
ask.title: Waits for a person
ask.others: Steps that wait for a person

list.title: Requests
list.leadOwn: The requests you made or own in {{project}}, newest first.
list.noMatchBody: Try other words, or another status.
list.noneBody: Requests show here from the moment they are submitted, with each step as it runs.

schedules.sheetBody: Its next times, and its last 20 runs, the newest first. Each run is a request of its own.
schedules.ownerIdle: Each run has the groups of their last sign-in, so a run is skipped once they haven't signed in for 90 days, or the number of days your administrator chose.
schedules.despiteWarnings: Each run goes on despite the policies' warnings.
schedules.pauseBody: It doesn't run until it is resumed; the times it misses meanwhile are skipped.
schedules.title: Schedules
schedules.lead: Requests made again and again in {{project}}, each as its owner: policies, approvals and quota check every run as they would a request of theirs.
schedules.noneBody: Request an item that makes no deployment, such as a custom workflow, and pick On a schedule under Start.
schedules.deleteBody: It doesn't run again. The requests it started stay, and still name it.

detail.stopsAfter: It stops after the current step and rolls back what it created.
detail.cancelRunning: The request stops after the step that is running now. The VM, IP address and DNS records it created are removed.
detail.cancelWaiting: The request is withdrawn before anything is created.
detail.fromServiceNow: From ServiceNow, <ritm>{{number}}<newTab> (opens in a new tab)</newTab></ritm>
detail.noAwxBody: This request has no AWX job, or it hasn't been planned yet.
detail.noStepBody: Choose Show data on a step to read what it was given and what it gave.
detail.warningsBody: The requester went on despite them.
detail.nothingAsked: Nothing: the item asks no questions.

lease.reminders: You get reminders 7 days and 1 day before.
lease.extendWarns: Extending it warns, and you may go on.
lease.lifetimeWarns_one: It lives {{count}} day at most: past that, an extension warns.
lease.lifetimeWarns_other: It lives {{count}} days at most: past that, an extension warns.
lease.lifetimeApproval_one: It lives {{count}} day at most: past that, an extension needs approval.
lease.lifetimeApproval_other: It lives {{count}} days at most: past that, an extension needs approval.
lease.longerWarns_one: Longer than {{count}} day warns, and you may go on.
lease.longerWarns_other: Longer than {{count}} days warns, and you may go on.
lease.none: Production deployments and AWX jobs have no lease.

env.label: Environment
env.production: Production: stricter policies and no lease.
env.other: Placement, quota and policies follow the environment.

summary.name: Name
summary.title: Summary
summary.eachRun: Each run is a request of its own, which policies, approvals and quota check as they check this one.
summary.eachRunApproval: Each run is a request of its own, which policies, approvals and quota check as they check this one: each waits for approval.
summary.startsLater: Provisioning starts at the time you chose.
summary.startsNow: Provisioning starts as soon as you submit.
summary.submitAnyway: You may submit anyway: the request keeps the warning.

toast.draftWhere: Find it under Requests, to finish later.

panels.name: Name (optional)
panels.unique: Unique in {{project}}. Left empty, rvav names it.
panels.descriptionHint: What it is for, shown with it.
panels.reasonPlaceholder: What is this for? Add a ticket number if there is one.
panels.howManyHint: Identical deployments, named one after the other (at most 20).
panels.whenApproved: As soon as it is approved
panels.whenSubmitted: As soon as it is submitted
panels.repeat: Again and again, on a schedule
panels.scheduleNameHint: Each run is a request of its own, which names it.
panels.cronTimes: At the times of a cron expression
panels.everyHint: From 5 minutes to 31 days, counted from 00:00 UTC: every day runs at midnight UTC. For a time of day, use a cron expression.
panels.cronHint: Minute, hour, day of month, month and day of week: 0 2 * * 1-5 is 2:00 on weekdays.
panels.timezoneHint: The IANA name the times are read in, such as Europe/Zurich.
panels.onBehalf: On behalf of {{name}} {{email}}: they will own it.

version.label: Version
version.newest: The newest. Earlier versions are still offered.
version.earlier: An earlier version: the newest is {{number}}.

page.elsewhere: This is in a project you don't work in: ask one of its members to request it.
page.title: Request {{name}}
